ValidationRule.description: Closing an intake lead as not converted requires a reason. Leads with no intake reference are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Intake_Ref__c)), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Not Converted"), ISBLANK(Qualification_Reason__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Qualification Reason is required when an intake lead is Closed - Not Converted.
